full_page.content:
1933, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 117 Cont.
June
Marian Hafeli - getting $75. p. month lost position after 5 yrs. - promises to go to Holy Com. every day for month and abstain from candy and sweets for one year - had to walk a mile to church. At end of week got call to new Job at $100.00 per month - shorter hours and all round more pleasant.
Blanke Case - $100,000.00 demanded 8 month ago, last week $100.00 now withdrawn.
Mrs. McCann - 80 last Jan. 6th - of Flint.
Mrs. Resico - 68 - lamenting Son (35) away from Church 17 yrs. Enrolled him May 22 & had prayers .... Made Easter with all earnest.
Guy Clements - 41 - of Bay City - Cancer of Stom. Mrs. - Convert - separated from .. Mrs. Julia Foley - 57 - nerveous
Mrs. Gawley - 50 - broken leg. .
Marie Glutting - 36 - something like paralysis
Sore Eyes - 67 - & another Cancer - Mr. Thomas - Eyes
Helen Brennan - 25 - in Providence Hospital - Streptococus - given up, Enrolled Sat., June 10th improves marvelously next day .... comes To-day in perfect health and pays for enrollment. Blank Page
Page 118 Page 119 June Mrs. Emma Betzing - 76 - cancer of - Husband 74 - just had stroke recently.
M.M. - 57 - Miss ... has been ideal - infatuated with unbeliever, sister etc anxious.
George Little - 8 - measles - Operation, etc, etc.
Miss Mary A. Kennedy - Pt. Huron - has sinus, Exima & bad heart Adele Fadoul - 22 - severe head-aches & chills, etc. Dr. & Mrs.
Joseph J. .. 55 - of Algonac - Heart -
